note: Quality numbers move one way. `tightest` is the strictest value each floor has ever been set to; harness-lint fails when the live config is looser than that. Loosening is still possible and sometimes necessary, but only through an explicit, dated override the owner approves — visible in the diff rather than buried in a config edit. `pnpm harness-lint --write` clicks a floor tighter; nothing clicks it back.

bundleTokens.why: A ceiling, so a HIGHER number is the loosening. It rose twice in three days, which is what prompted this file.

mutationBreak.why: A floor, so a LOWER number is the loosening. This is the one an agent stuck on a red build has the clearest motive to touch.
